texts.content: {"text":"Today we're comparing two ways to work on a dbt project,","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf","id":""},"strokes":[{"content":{"solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}},"width":0.08}],"size":5,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,56]}]}

{"text":"before you can open that project and start working.","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf","id":""},"strokes":[{"content":{"solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}},"width":0.08}],"size":5,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,51]}]}

{"text":"If you've set dbt up locally before, you know how this goes.","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf","id":""},"strokes":[{"content":{"solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}},"width":0.08}],"size":5,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,60]}]}

{"text":"then dbt and the Postgres adapter installed into it.","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf","id":""},"strokes":[{"content":{"solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}},"width":0.08}],"size":5,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,52]}]}

{"text":"The project brings its models and its config,","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf","id":""},"strokes":[{"content":{"solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}},"width":0.08}],"size":5,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,45]}]}

{"text":"so you write a profiles file by hand","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf","id":""},"strokes":[{"content":{"solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}},"width":0.08}],"size":5,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,36]}]}

{"text":"into a hidden folder in your home directory.","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf","id":""},"strokes":[{"content":{"solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}},"width":0.08}],"size":5,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,44]}]}

{"text":"Then dbt debug, which tells you there is no project here","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf","id":""},"strokes":[{"content":{"solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}},"width":0.08}],"size":5,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,56]}]}

{"text":"You point it at the project folder, or a zip,","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf","id":""},"strokes":[{"content":{"solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}},"width":0.08}],"size":5,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,45]}]}

{"text":"and installs dbt and its adapters for you.","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf","id":""},"strokes":[{"content":{"solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}},"width":0.08}],"size":5,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,42]}]}

{"text":"So the project is open on both sides.","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf","id":""},"strokes":[{"content":{"solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}},"width":0.08}],"size":5,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,37]}]}

{"text":"There are two ways to do that on the dbt side.","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf","id":""},"strokes":[{"content":{"solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}},"width":0.08}],"size":5,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,46]}]}

{"text":"The codegen package prints the code to your terminal,","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf","id":""},"strokes":[{"content":{"solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}},"width":0.08}],"size":5,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,53]}]}

{"text":"one table at a time, for you to paste into a file.","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf","id":""},"strokes":[{"content":{"solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}},"width":0.08}],"size":5,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,50]}]}

{"text":"and generates a model straight from a source with a click.","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf","id":""},"strokes":[{"content":{"solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}},"width":0.08}],"size":5,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,58]}]}

{"text":"But both of them handle one table per call,","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf","id":""},"strokes":[{"content":{"solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}},"width":0.08}],"size":5,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,43]}]}

{"text":"and they're not really the same kind of thing.","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf","id":""},"strokes":[{"content":{"solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}},"width":0.08}],"size":5,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,46]}]}

{"text":" Power User's AI runs on Altimate's service,","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf","id":""},"strokes":[{"content":{"solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}},"width":0.08}],"size":5,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,44]}]}

{"text":"which means your schema goes off to their cloud to be read.","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf","id":""},"strokes":[{"content":{"solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}},"width":0.08}],"size":5,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,59]}]}

{"text":"right inside VS Code. Where it stops is storage.","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf","id":""},"strokes":[{"content":{"solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}},"width":0.08}],"size":5,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,48]}]}

{"styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1.0,"color":[1.0,1.0,1.0]}}},"font":{"id":"","path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf"},"range":[0,38],"size":5,"strokes":[{"alpha":1.0,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1.0,"color":[0.0,0.0,0.0]}},"width":0.08}],"useLetterColor":true}],"text":"and they turn up in the same download."}

{"text":"open source, and it runs on your machine,","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf","id":""},"strokes":[{"content":{"solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}},"width":0.08}],"size":5,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,41]}]}

{"text":"and no profiles file to write by hand. ","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf","id":""},"strokes":[{"content":{"solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}},"width":0.08}],"size":5,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,39]}]}

{"text":"a star on GitHub helps other people find it.","styles":[{"fill":{"content":{"solid":{"color":[1,1,1]}}},"font":{"path":"%CAPCUT_LOCAL%/CapCut/Capcut-3.3.0/3.3.0.1161/Resources/Font/SystemFont/en.ttf","id":""},"strokes":[{"content":{"solid":{"color":[0,0,0]}},"width":0.08}],"size":5,"useLetterColor":true,"range":[0,44]}]}
